response.original_title: The March of Time, Vol. 5, No. 9: Japan - Master of the Orient
response.overview: Japan's huge military machine and its present drain on the nation's resources is shown. Presents some views of Japan never before seen and which are likely to be closely studied in this country as well as in various European Chancellories.
